name: Golden Apple Archipelago/2.8
description: Golden Apple Archipelago in the Summertime Odyssey event during Version 2.8. The requirements to unlock the Golden Archipelago is: Reach Adventure Rank 32 or above. Complete the Archon Quest "Chapter II: Prologue - Autumn Winds, Scarlet Leaves". Complete Mona's Story Quest "Astrolabos Chapter: Act I - Beyond This World's Stars". Players can skip this requirement by entering the Summertime Odyssey event through "Quick Start." Sufficiently progress in The Golden Apple Vacation Returns!
